what: JavaScript looked for `{1}` in the current scope and did not find it. It was never created, or it was created in a different scope.

street.headline: You call `{1}`, but JavaScript no sabi am
street.happen: You dey call `{1}` like say JavaScript know am, but e no sabi who be that. You never introduce am o.
street.learn: "not defined" mean say the variable no dey anywhere JavaScript fit see.

normal.headline: JavaScript no sabi `{1}`
normal.happen: You dey use `{1}`, but JavaScript no sabi am. You never create am.
